R=C=26
grid=[[0]*C for _ in range(R)]
def putpix(color, origin, rels):
 r0,c0=origin
 for dr,dc in rels:
  r,c=r0+dr,c0+dc
  if not (0<=r<R and 0<=c<C): print('out',color,r,c); continue
  if grid[r][c] not in (0,color): print('COLLISION',r,c,grid[r][c],color)
  grid[r][c]=color
def putdots(origin,rels):
 r0,c0=origin
 for dr,dc in rels:
  r,c=r0+dr,c0+dc
  if not (0<=r<R and 0<=c<C): print('dot out',r,c); continue
  if grid[r][c]==0: grid[r][c]=2
  elif grid[r][c]==2: pass
  else: print('dot over pixel',r,c,grid[r][c])
# 7 bbox
